name: Smawverse
description:
About This Game

Smawverse is a dark fantasy bullet heaven, a survivor-like roguelite where your weapons fight for you. You play a stray cat reforged in iron, carving through the undead wreck of a kingdom that fell to its own keeper. Built in Unreal Engine 5.

Pray to the Nine

Nine prophets once held the kingdom together. Now they meditate in stone. Kneel at their shrines and they loan you a fragment of the power that was once theirs.

  • Nine prophets, each a distinct element: fire, frost, plague, shadow, arcane, and more.

  • Choose blessings as you level mid-run. No two runs play the same.

  • Forty-plus blessings to discover across the Nine.

  • Stack them deep enough and one cat becomes a screen-clearing storm.

Survive the Unmade

The kingdom's own keeper raised its dead and struck the living from the page. What remains wants you gone.

  • Hordes that escalate until the screen is a wall of enemies.

  • Eight weapons, each a completely different playstyle.

  • Bosses that end your run if you built wrong.

  • Permadeath. The blessings return when you fall. You rise again sharper.

Grow Between Runs

Death is not the end of progress. Everything you earn carries forward into the next descent.

  • Prophet Skill Tree: a deep passive tree with a chapter for every prophet. Earn Prophet experience from the shrines you favor and spend Talent Scrolls from bosses on build-defining keystones.

Weapon Mastery: every weapon levels on its own the more you fight with it, unlocking support nodes and a signature keystone.

  • The Cipher Station: some loot drops with affixes you cannot read. Start deciphering and there is no backing out. You commit, then choose between the original roll and a hidden alternate. Whichever you keep comes out stronger.

  • Capes: unlock a wardrobe of prophet-themed cloaks by mastering each prophet. Some carry a small edge in battle.

  • A hideout that restores as you progress, the last standing corner of a fallen street, with a stash that carries between runs.

The Story, For Those Who Want It

There was a kingdom called the Daughter of the Sea. Its strength was not armies. It was nine prophets, one sacred scripture called the Word, and a people who fed each other's cats. The man who kept the Word wanted the power it would never give him. So he took it, and he unmade the kingdom with it. The prophets had one failsafe left: a word that could never be written, and a stray cat to carry it. That cat is you.

One cat. Nine prophets. A stolen scripture and the thing that took it. Take back the Word.
short_desc: Cut down the risen dead in this dark fantasy bullet-heaven roguelike. You are Smaw, a stray cat reforged in iron to take back a kingdom unmade by its own keeper. Kneel at nine prophet shrines and stack their blessings into screen-clearing builds. How long can you last?
